name: maybe_Data_GetSpeakerRecordBit6
signature: u32 maybe_Data_GetSpeakerRecordBit6(u32 context, u32 speakerId, u32 arg3, u32* arg4)
summary: Resolves a speaker row via the data manager and returns bit 6 of the byte at record+0x16, or 0 when the row is missing. The 'window placement' reading is unsupported; it is a single flag bit from a speaker record.
evidence: Body only calls Game_GetDataManager and the row finder 0x0063D85C, then returns (f_16 & 0x7F) >> 6; no callers and no placement value, so the name stays a guess.

name: maybe_Data_GetPlateRecordAttr
summary: Validates the plate handle at +0x2C, looks up the plate's index (+0x49) in a data table and returns the record's byte at +0x17, or 0 when invalid.
evidence: Takes a plate pointer, no float; returns record->f_17 from the table via 0x0063D270; caller 0x0063469C uses the result as a condition. Table and validator unnamed.

name: maybe_Data_GetRecordS8At10
summary: Pure getter: if the id at self+4 is not -1, looks it up in a data table and returns the signed byte at record+10, else 0. The 'casino slot payout' reading is unverified.
evidence: No callers; only Game_GetDataManager and 0x0063F2F0 are called; returns *(char*)(record+10). Table identity unknown.

name: maybe_Data_GetLabelString
summary: Returns a label string for a record: inline text at self+0x22 when the id is -1, otherwise the record's relative string or the inline buffer at self+0xC depending on the record flag at +0xA.
evidence: Body returns pointers into self or into the record resolved via Game_GetDataManager/0x0063F2F0; consumers use the result as a string. No direct callers listed.

name: maybe_Data_IsSlotAllocated
summary: Compares two virtual lookups (+0x48 with 0, +0x64 with slotIndex) and, when they differ, resolves a record via the data manager and returns bit 0 of its +0x80 flags.
evidence: Only named callee is Game_GetDataManager; no callers; both 'ActorModels' and 'IsSlotEmpty' are inferences from vtable offsets.

name: maybe_Data_ValidateGroupSlots
signature: unsigned int maybe_Data_ValidateGroupSlots(char* groups, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int* arg3, unsigned int manager)
summary: Walks each group's declared slots and returns 0 as soon as a slot still holds the 0xFF unset sentinel, otherwise 1. Used by training/choice windows to test completeness.
evidence: Loop tests 0xFF sentinels over group slot counts; callers are Ui_TrainingWindow_UpdateInput and choice-select windows; only Game_GetDataManager named.

name: maybe_Data_ResolveRelativeEntry8
signature: void* maybe_Data_ResolveRelativeEntry8(unsigned short* key, GroupRecord* group, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int manager)
summary: Follows the group's relative offset at +8, falling back to the record found by (key - base) and its own +8 relative link; returns null when nothing resolves.
evidence: Pointer arithmetic on group+8 and record+8; only Game_GetDataManager and 0x0063CDD8 named; no callers.

name: Data_ResolveRelativeEntry4
signature: void* Data_ResolveRelativeEntry4(unsigned short* key, GroupRecord* group, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int manager)
summary: Resolves the +4 relative link of a group/entry record, falling back to the record found by (key - base) and its +4 link. Heavily used by equipment and item UI code.
evidence: Same body shape as 0x0066BF5C but for the +4 link; 12 callers including Party_Member_EquipInventorySlot, Party_ValidateEquipment, Ui_EquipWindow_CanEquipSelected and Battle_Equip_UpdateArmourSlot, so it is a shared data-record resolver.
